Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Desired Skills & Qualifications Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role Mainframe Ecosystem Literacy: Foundational knowledge of the z/OS environment, including familiarity with TSO/ISPF. Direct experience with using or managing mainframe schedulers or Workload Automation products. Experience with CA 7 and/or Jobtrac a plus. Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Database Management Systems team in the Mainframe Software Division. The SDET will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing comprehensive test plans and strategies to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. This role requires a strong understanding of software testing methodologies, a proven ability to work in Agile and DevOps environments, and a commitment to continuous improvement in software quality. The ideal candidate will possess over 5 years of experience in mainframe software quality assurance, with a track record of successfully implementing automated testing solutions and contributing to high-quality software releases. Work Location for this position is in our Plano, TX office. Key Responsibilities: Quality Assurance & Automated Testing: Actively participate in Agile team activities, providing expert guidance on testing requirements, effort estimation, and risk assessment. Design and develop programs, utilities, scripts, and pipelines to support various testing streams including Integration, System, Performance, Security, and Compatibility. Implement and report on automated test coverage strategies, providing insightful analysis of coverage metrics. Update and maintain automated regression tests, ensuring their effectiveness in identifying newly introduced defects. Analyze automated test results, including the review and resolution of false positives and the refactoring of fragile tests. Execute targeted manual and exploratory testing for critical functionalities and high-risk areas. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate potential security vulnerabilities within the testing process, tools, and application under test. Prepare complex test data and ensure test case execution aligns with comprehensive testing matrices. Leadership & Strategic Planning: Contribute to the definition and documentation of comprehensive test frameworks, including the selection of technology stacks and test automation tools. Support the design and implementation of Continuous Testing pipelines within Agile and DevOps environments. Assist in establishing performance testing baselines and defining benchmarking strategies. Provide guidance on industry-standard testing processes (e.g., BDD, TDD) and contribute to the development of automated and manual testing strategies. Review product code changes to design optimal test cases and strategies, ensuring comprehensive coverage and risk mitigation. Required Qualifications: Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in software quality assurance, with experience in Databases technologies. Experience with mainframe environments (z/OS) Strong understanding and practical application of software testing methodologies, principles, and best practices. Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, or C. Extensive experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, PyTest, or similar. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and platforms (e.g., Jenkins). Proven experience in designing and executing performance, load, and scalability testing for enterprise-level applications. Desired Skills & Experience: Experience programming in IBM Assembler (HLASM), REXX, Metal C is a plus. Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RESTAssured, SoapUI). Relevant industry certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager, SAFe Agilist (SA). Job Description: Equipment Engineer - Metrology The Wireless Semiconductor Division (WSD) designs and develops highly integrated, state-of-the-art RF front-end solutions for use in mobile communications and WiFi access points. Familiarity applying Lean manufacturing, Six-Sigma, and similar principles to complex issues. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Job Description: WSD Fort Collins Equipment Maintenance C-Shift (S,M,T, alternating Weds, 6PM-6AM) Supervisor – Job Description Equipment Maintenance Shift Supervisor As an Equipment Maintenance Shift Supervisor with the Wireless Semiconductor Division (WSD), you will be responsible for collaborating with fab operations, equipment engineering, and equipment area teams to sustain and improve equipment reliability and performance, while in support of overall safety, yield, reliability, and productivity goals. You will provide dotted-line management for all equipment maintenance technicians on your assigned shift, as well as take direct responsibility for the equipment support technicians on your shift. The shift supervisor will be responsible for managing a challenging environment, driving continuous improvement initiatives in our existing high-volume Si MEMS production facilities located along the Front Range Mountains in Northern Colorado. We are looking to hire a talented, highly motivated leader responsible for challenging and rewarding work. Specific Objectives and Key Responsibilities: Lead team to deliver safe, stable, and reliable equipment performance. Lead and direct shift technician resources consistent with business-changing needs. Act as the escalation contact for emergency concerns, attendance, etc. Work with Equipment Maintenance Area Supervisors to implement global initiatives (RTQ, PM Checklist, CMMS, LOTO, escalations, CribMaster (automated hand tool system), PM kits, documentation review, etc.) consistent with equipment team standards and improve cross-shift communication performance. Partner with Fab Operations supervisors to ensure our customer and factory needs are understood and met. Allocate resources to the highest priority areas as defined by fab operations. Realign resources based on vacation, call-ins, training, and other area coverage issues. Resolve conflicts between PM schedules and reactive fab operations priorities. Coordinate solutions to equipment issues and involve required resources early on to prevent extended downtime. Encourage precision and excellence when performing maintenance, troubleshooting, and communication activities. Conduct thorough observations of practices and adherence to protocols and procedures, including LOTO activity audits. Enhance the standardization of processes while spending time on the factory floor. Point of contact to drive and support advanced troubleshooting and escalation for the shift. Responsible for ensuring and supporting the training and certification programs in place for the equipment maintenance technicians in their functional area. Provide feedback on global training shift needs. In the absence of the responsible EM Area Supervisor, provide the necessary management intervention for any HR issue that may arise on your shift. Carefully coordinate your actions with that employee’s EM Area Supervisor & HR in a timely manner. Provide input to the EM Area Supervisor for measuring employee performance utilizing the Quarterly Performance Form process (QPF). Drive and support equipment maintenance metric adherence including communication and corrective action plans. Function as project/program manager for assigned cross-functional needs (e.g. Hand Tools Calibration program, CribMaster program, Pack Mule improvement project, AMHS Delivery System, etc.). Drive assigned projects through completion utilizing the PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) process as needed. Participate in the selection & hiring of new technicians for your shift. Provide active direct management of the Equipment Support Team technicians assigned to your shift. Growth, development, accountability, and performance efficiency Drives organizational accountability to policies and procedures Drives continuous improvement with forward-thinking on safety and quality Manage hiring resources as needed Serve as a sounding board and source of advice for employees at any career stage (e.g., new hires through Master Level Technicians). This may encompass technical challenges or personnel/work-relationship difficulties. Skills and Qualifications: Preferred Bachelor’s degree in a related field Required Associate in Applied Science degree in Electronics Engineering Technology or equivalent technical degree. Preferred 8-10 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing processes, equipment maintenance, and related challenges. Preferred experience includes previous management in equipment maintenance, with a strong emphasis on problem-solving, preventive maintenance planning, time management, and organizational skills. Candidates should possess electrical and mechanical technical knowledge of equipment, along with analytical reasoning abilities. Also has a proven track record of effectively managing a team of technical experts. Demonstrated technical expertise, leadership, and the ability to develop and mentor employees. Demonstrated ability to balance long-term and short-term goals and manage competing priorities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Experienced team player/team leader. Ability to resolve conflict constructively. The successful candidate is required to participate on Broadcom's Emergency Response Team (ERT). This includes working towards becoming an ERT Incident Commander, leading events, making strategic decisions, and serving as a point of contact for emergency events. Data-driven and results-oriented. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Attention to detail is essential. Initiative to address and appropriately escalate problems to achieve rapid resolution. Broadcom, a global innovator in fabless communications semiconductors, software, and systems, is proud to be recognized as one of Fortune magazine's "Most Admired Companies." Verify the design, architecture, and micro-architecture using emulation platforms. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling ��— Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6+ years of related experience. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Job Description: Broadcom’s Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions, including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. Our team is behind iconic switching solutions like the Tomahawk and Trident series, setting benchmarks in the networking world. Broadcom, a global innovator in fabless communications semiconductors, software, and systems, is proud to be recognized as one of Fortune magazine's "Most Admired Companies." We foster a culture that embraces change, values risk-taking, and thrives on tackling the impossible. At Broadcom, we reward innovation and initiative with competitive salaries, industry-leading benefits, and opportunities for growth in an open, collaborative work environment. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6+ years of related experience. Job Description: The ASIC Products Division at Broadcom has developed some of the most complex IC solutions and technologies over the last two decades. Our products power the internet in areas such as machine learning, cloud computing, wireless infrastructure, and networking. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Desired Skills & Qualifications Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role Mainframe Ecosystem Literacy: Foundational knowledge of the z/OS environment, including familiarity with TSO/ISPF. Comfort with JCL and general programming to understand job failures or resource constraints and their potential impact. Direct experience with using or managing mainframe schedulers or Workload Automation products. Experience with CA 7 and/or Jobtrac a plus. Strong business acumen with ability to perform impact analysis for missed batch windows and translate business requirements into jobs run in workload schedulers. Job Description: The Core Switch Group (CSG) at Broadcom is the industry leader in cutting-edge networking ASICs, developing advanced protocols and delivering unmatched port density and bandwidth performance. Our team is behind iconic switching solutions like the Tomahawk and Trident series, setting benchmarks in the networking world. Broadcom, a global innovator in fabless communications semiconductors, software, and systems, is proud to be recognized as one of Fortune magazine's "Most Admired Companies." We foster a culture that embraces change, values risk-taking, and thrives on tackling the impossible. At Broadcom, we reward innovation and initiative with competitive salaries, industry-leading benefits, and opportunities for growth in an open, collaborative work environment. If you're a passionate engineer eager to shape the future of networking, Broadcom is where you can outdo, outsmart, and outperform. Join us and make an impact! Key Responsibilities Conduct detailed studies of chip architecture and micro-architecture to define, develop, and execute comprehensive pre-silicon test plans that thoroughly validate switch features. Verify the design, architecture, and micro-architecture using emulation platforms. Develop sub-system and chip-level tests using Tcl, ITcl, Python, and C/C++ to verify networking switch chips in emulation platforms. Build and synthesize Verilog/SystemVerilog-based models for emulation platforms such as Zebu or Palladium. Collaborate with post-silicon and system teams to correlate pre-silicon validation results with field observations and ensure architectural intent is maintained in deployed systems. Develop and optimize automation scripts and emulation methodologies to improve efficiency, reusability, and coverage. Create reusable synthesizable design blocks, libraries, and verification components to streamline emulation processes. Build and maintain robust emulation environments that support a global user community. Strong expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog, C/C++, and scripting languages (Tcl, Python) for test development and automation. Hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms (e.g., Zebu, Palladium) and familiarity with high-speed protocols such as PCIe and Ethernet. Deep debugging expertise, including use of DPI transactors, assertions, and coverage methodologies. Experience working cross-functionally with architecture, design, and software teams to ensure architectural intent and silicon quality. Strong communication skills and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Verification engineers with simulation backgrounds are also encouraged to apply — strong verification fundamentals are highly valued. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6+ years of related experience. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Desired Skills & Qualifications Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role Mainframe Ecosystem Literacy: Foundational knowledge of the z/OS environment, including familiarity with TSO/ISPF. Direct experience with using or managing mainframe schedulers or Workload Automation products. Experience with CA 7 and/or Jobtrac a plus. Strong business acumen with ability to perform impact analysis for missed batch windows and translate business requirements into jobs run in workload schedulers. Job Description: The Core Switch Group (CSG) at Broadcom is the industry leader in cutting-edge networking ASICs, developing advanced protocols and delivering unmatched port density and bandwidth performance. Our team is behind iconic switching solutions like the Tomahawk and Trident series, setting benchmarks in the networking world. Broadcom, a global innovator in fabless communications semiconductors, software, and systems, is proud to be recognized as one of Fortune magazine's "Most Admired Companies." We foster a culture that embraces change, values risk-taking, and thrives on tackling the impossible. At Broadcom, we reward innovation and initiative with competitive salaries, industry-leading benefits, and opportunities for growth in an open, collaborative work environment. If you're a passionate engineer eager to shape the future of networking, Broadcom is where you can outdo, outsmart, and outperform. Join us and make an impact! Key Responsibilities Conduct detailed studies of chip architecture and micro-architecture to define, develop, and execute comprehensive pre-silicon test plans that thoroughly validate switch features. Verify the design, architecture, and micro-architecture using emulation platforms. Develop sub-system and chip-level tests using Tcl, ITcl, Python, and C/C++ to verify networking switch chips in emulation platforms. Build and synthesize Verilog/SystemVerilog-based models for emulation platforms such as Zebu or Palladium. Perform block-, sub-system-, and chip/system-level debugging and root cause analysis for hardware and software issues, addressing pre-silicon challenges. Support failure analysis of customer-returned parts by reproducing failures, performing deep root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions teams. Collaborate with post-silicon and system teams to correlate pre-silicon validation results with field observations and ensure architectural intent is maintained in deployed systems. Develop and optimize automation scripts and emulation methodologies to improve efficiency, reusability, and coverage. Create reusable synthesizable design blocks, libraries, and verification components to streamline emulation processes. Build and maintain robust emulation environments that support a global user community. What You Bring Proven ability to define verification strategy and drive execution at block, sub-system, and chip levels for networking ASICs. 8+ years of experience in pre-silicon verification and/or emulation of high-performance networking designs. Strong expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog, C/C++, and scripting languages (Tcl, Python) for test development and automation. Hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms (e.g., Zebu, Palladium) and familiarity with high-speed protocols such as PCIe and Ethernet. Deep debugging expertise, including use of DPI transactors, assertions, and coverage methodologies. Experience working cross-functionally with architecture, design, and software teams to ensure architectural intent and silicon quality. Strong communication skills and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Verification engineers with simulation backgrounds are also encouraged to apply — strong verification fundamentals are highly valued. Wireline Field Operator Delivering Flawless Wireline Execution Baker Hughes is a global leader in wireline services, offering a massive portfolio designed to evaluate, build, and maintain wells through every stage of their lifecycle. Fuel your passion Baker Hughes wireline services runs both in open hole and cased hole wells. Open Hole services offering formation evaluation, fluid sampling, acoustic & nuclear technology. Data Acquisition: Assist the engineer in recording geological or mechanical data via electronic logging sensors. Perforation: Deploy explosive charges to create holes in the well casing to allow oil or gas to flow. Maintenance and Technical Support Cable Care: Inspect the wireline for "kinks," bird-caging, or wear; perform regular lubrication and "re-heading" (replacing the cable socket). Tool Troubleshooting: Perform field repairs on mechanical tools and ensure all sensors are calibrated. Post-Job Maintenance: Clean, decontaminate, and inventory all equipment before leaving the site. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6+ years of related experience.
